defect: In role-local ROBDD experiment code, `_rank`/`rankrec` stores its intended cache key in local variable `k=(u,level)` and later reuses the same Python variable name `k` as an enumerate loop index before `self.rank_cache[k]=...`. Nonterminal rank results are therefore stored under small integer loop indices rather than `(node,level)` tuples and are not memoized on subsequent recursive lookup. Terminal tuple keys remain unaffected. The recursion still computes exact vectors, but rank-cache-state counts and rank/runtime performance claims are invalid until corrected.
scope_audit: Exact rank-vector values remain candidates for retention only if fixed-cache and buggy-cache evaluators agree against independent closed-form or fresh direct truth/count oracles.

ROBDD live/allocated node counts, candidate-compilation counts, accepted relocation moves, widths, rebuild counts and allocation/live ratios are computed outside rank-cache indexing and are not mechanically changed by this defect.
Any wall-clock result that included rank evaluation is downgraded to non-authoritative until a fixed-cache rerun on new or explicitly correction-scoped cells.
Any reported `rank_cache_states` from affected code is invalid.
predeclared_correction_tests: Microreproduce shadowing: after ranking a nontrivial OBDD, buggy cache keys must include integers and omit most reachable nonterminal `(node,level)` keys; fixed cache must use tuple keys and visit/cache every reachable nonterminal path state needed by the recursion.

For constructed equivalence formulas m=4,6,8,10,12 under interleaved and blocked orders, buggy and fixed rank vectors must both equal closed-form `(1+z^2)^m`; compare only fixed-cache performance/cache metrics.

Rerun the relative rebuild-controller design with fixed rank memoization on a new holdout before making runtime comparisons; retain prior exactness/rebuild/allocation results only within their unaffected scope.
Do not overwrite old result artifacts; append correction evidence and supersede timing interpretations in newest checkpoint/LATEST.
scope: Correction of local experiment instrumentation/performance accounting only; no semantic change to monotone-boundary theorem or proof-library authority.
